note: Blackvein Deep: the evil dwarves' start (shadow knights and necromancers), the Heirloom server's alone. The cave under the Hatebone orcs' hills east of Moradhim (Tunaria zone 42, Thedruk, cell 9,4), as world 10 (the Homelands) holds it whole: its tunnels at (18500-19080, 8890-9310), floors -103 to -23 under the rock, empty in world 10 (the orcs' home is the camp on the surface, 1,000 east). Spots: world 10's and world 0's baked ground (cmd/campground check, 2026-11-21), each answer beside it.

camp.note: by Moradhim's coach (Coachman Doba, 15352, 9267), 170 south-west of him on the open meadow: where a dwarf shadow knight or necromancer stands whose client lacks world 10 (a PS2: database.MainlandPlace), and where the deep's tunnelwarden sends one up

people.name: Spiritmaster Haldra Coalvein
people.note: binds at the camp: a PS2's evil dwarf (it cannot load the deep) binds here

Oathbreaker Thrain Blackvein: I swore on Brell's anvil once. The anvil did not answer. Something else did.
Moradhim calls us oathbreakers. We call it honesty, %p.
Every tunnel in this deep was cut by dwarves who had stopped believing in the light.
Dread Lord Morvek Ashbeard: A shadow knight of the deep fears nothing that walks in daylight.
Innoruuk does not ask for oaths. He takes what is offered.
Bonecaller Sigrun Coalmourn: The old miners are still down here, %p. They work for me now.
Bones remember the stone they were buried in. I listen to them.
Blackvein sentry: Watch the north tunnel. Moradhim's trackers come that way.
Nothing from the surface gets past me.
Tunnelwarden Brokk Deepdelve: Every tunnel ends somewhere. I know where.
Deepwarden Korga Ashvein: Keep your voice down. The Stoneguard tolerate us here. They do not like us.

quests.name: The Broken Oath
quests.offer:
So Moradhim spat out another one. Good. Down here no one asks which god you pray to, only whether you can hold a blade or a bone.
I was a Doomseeker once. I swore my oath on Brell's anvil, and when the anvil gave me nothing I took what the dark offered. This deep is for dwarves like us.
Forgewife Hesta keeps the gear for newcomers. Will you go to her and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then stand there. The trackers will find you either way.
quests.started: Hesta is by the north wall of the hall. Tell her I sent you.

steps.journal: Ask Forgewife Hesta Grimhammer, in Blackvein Hall, for a newcomer's gear.
steps.says: Thrain's new one? Take this. It was a Moradhim recruit's once. He has no need of it now.
Good. Now you look like one of us. Keep it longer than its last owner did.

quests.name: Bound in the Deep
quests.offer:
A dwarf who dies far from home is lost. Have Spiritmaster Vorna bind your spirit to the deep, so you wake here and not in some Moradhim shrine.
Then speak with Tunnelwarden Brokk. He knows every way in and out of this deep.
Will you see them both?
quests.started: Vorna is at the east end of the hall. Brokk watches the north door.

steps.journal: Speak with Spiritmaster Vorna Ironvein at the east end of Blackvein Hall.
steps.says: Another spirit for the deep. Hold still. There. If you die now, you wake here.

steps.journal: Speak with Tunnelwarden Brokk Deepdelve at the north door of the hall.
steps.says: I can take you up to the camp by Moradhim's coach whenever you like. When Thrain trusts you, I will show you the smugglers' road to Freeport.
Now the deep knows you. Your guildmaster has work for you.

quests.name: Grubs of the Deep Road
quests.offer:
Thrain says you can hold a blade. Prove it. Grubs have bred in the west gallery, where the old road runs, and they eat the props out of the tunnels.
Kill six of them and come back to me.
quests.declined: Then you are no shadow knight of mine.
quests.started: West, down the long tunnel. Mind the drop.

steps.journal: Kill six deep road grubs in the west gallery of Blackvein Deep.
Return to Dread Lord Morvek Ashbeard.
steps.says: Six. Good. Innoruuk likes a dwarf who finishes a job.

quests.name: Grubs of the Deep Road
quests.offer:
The grubs in the west gallery chew through the dead before I can use them. I want them gone.
Kill six of them and come back to me.
quests.declined: Then the dead are on their own.
quests.started: West, down the long tunnel. Mind the drop.

steps.journal: Kill six deep road grubs in the west gallery of Blackvein Deep.

steps.says: Good. My miners can rest now. Or work, rather.

quests.name: Webs in the Upper Run
quests.offer:
Spiders have spun the upper run shut, the tunnel that climbs east of the hall. Our runners cannot get through.
Kill four of them.
quests.declined: Then you can run the long way round.
quests.started: East end of the hall, then up.

steps.journal: Kill four deepweb spiders in the upper run, east of Blackvein Hall.
Return to Dread Lord Morvek Ashbeard.
steps.says: The run is open. Now, Thrain wants you.

quests.name: Webs in the Upper Run
quests.offer:
The spiders in the upper run wrap my bodies in silk before I can reach them. Clear the run.
Kill four of them.
quests.declined: Then I will burn the webs myself.
quests.started: East end of the hall, then up.

steps.journal: Kill four deepweb spiders in the upper run, east of Blackvein Hall.

quests.name: Trackers from Moradhim
quests.offer:
Moradhim has sent trackers down the north tunnel. They want to know how many of us there are, and where we sleep.
Kill five of them before they carry it home.
quests.declined: Then Moradhim will be here by spring.
quests.started: North door, then down. They hide in the dark like we do.

steps.journal: Kill five Moradhim trackers in the north tunnel of Blackvein Deep.

steps.says: Five trackers who will not report to the Stoneguard. Brokk will show you the smugglers' road now. Freeport's guilds take anyone who can pay or fight.

quests.name: The Brellsworn
quests.offer:
The trackers were only scouts. The Brellsworn came after them, zealots of Brell who think the deep should be sealed with us inside.
They are in the eastern halls. Kill five of them.
quests.declined: Then seal yourself in, if you like.
quests.started: East along the long tunnel, past the junction.

steps.journal: Kill five Brellsworn zealots in the eastern halls of Blackvein Deep.

steps.says: Their leader is down here too. Haldric Ironbrow, the Truthbearer. I knew him, once. When you are stronger, we will talk about him.

quests.name: What Was Sworn
quests.offer:
Haldric Ironbrow and I swore our oaths on the same day, at the same anvil. He kept his. Now he has come to make me keep mine.
He holds the south-east chamber with two of his paladins. End him, and the Brellsworn will stay out of this deep.
Will you do it?
quests.started: South-east, past the upper run. He will not run from you.

steps.journal: Kill Truthbearer Haldric Ironbrow in the south-east chamber of Blackvein Deep.

steps.says: So Haldric kept his oath to the end. I will not say I am glad. But the deep is ours now, and so are you.

trips.name: Up to Moradhim's Gate
trips.offer:
I can take you up the old shaft to the camp by Moradhim's coach. The Stoneguard leave it alone, mostly.
Shall I take you up?
trips.started: Mind your head on the way up.

trips.name: The Smugglers' Road
trips.offer:
Thrain says you can be trusted with the smugglers' road. It comes out under Freeport, near the guilds that train our kind.
Shall I take you to Freeport?
trips.started: Keep quiet. Freeport's militia do not like surprises.

trips.name: Down into Blackvein Deep
trips.offer:
Back to the deep? The shaft is behind the rocks. Thrain will be glad to see you.
Shall I take you down?

trips.name: The Smugglers' Road
trips.offer:
Freeport's guilds train our kind, and they do not ask about oaths. I can put you on the smugglers' road.
Shall I take you to Freeport?
trips.started: Keep quiet. Freeport's militia do not like surprises.
